aboutDescription: A second brain for connecting ideas and building understanding in one knowledge graph, built on a small core with a simple plugin system.
introConceptDescription: Something familiar is enough. **Connections** give it **context**.
introConnectionsDescription: Coffee boosts energy, but can disrupt sleep. Both affect focus. Exploring **connections** helps you understand concepts from different angles. Create and use **views** to focus on different parts of the same graph.
introUnderstandingDescription: Use the **Inspector** to explore and edit concepts, connections, and views.
introUnderstandingDesktopDescription: In the Inspector, use **Details** to explore and edit concepts, connections, and views. Switch to **Chat** to ask questions and build your graph with AI.
introDesktopDescription: Nesso also supports AI chat and an MCP server. Download the desktop app from {{website}} for the full experience.
storageDescription: Nesso’s graph, preferences and conversation. Credentials stay on this device in the default folder.
storageRestoreConfirm: The new folder will be {{path}} again.
storageCloud: With a cloud-synced folder, keep files available offline and do not edit from multiple devices.
storageMovingDescription: Do not close Nesso or disconnect a drive. Editing is paused until the transfer is complete.
storageVerifying: Saving, transferring and verifying your files.
storageMoved: Data moved. Nesso is now saving only in the new folder.
storageSame: This folder is already active. No change is needed.
storageConfig: The data folder configuration could not be read. No existing data was replaced.
storageUnavailable: The folder is unavailable. Check that it exists and any external drive is connected.
storageDestination: Choose a destination using the folder picker.
storageNested: Choose a folder that is not inside the current data folder or one of its parents.
storageOccupied: The folder already contains files. Choose an empty folder. Existing data will not be merged or overwritten.
storageReadonly: Nesso cannot write to this folder. Check its permissions or choose another folder.
storageSource: The current folder contains an unsupported data file. The transfer was not completed.
storageSpace: There is not enough free space in the destination. Free up space or choose another folder.
storageVerification: File verification failed. The original folder remains active.
storageMoveFailure: The move could not be completed. Check space, permissions and drives. The original folder remains active; partial files may remain in the destination.
storageCleanup: Some transfer files could not be safely removed. The displayed folder is active. Check drives and permissions, resolve any partial or externally changed files, then retry cleanup.
storageBusy: Finish or stop active AI chats or MCP requests, then retry. Another transfer or update installation may also be in progress.
storageSaveFailure: Changes could not be saved in every window. The original folder remains active. Resolve storage errors and retry.
storageOpenFailure: Could not open the data folder. Check that it is still accessible.
mcpDescription: Connect external assistants to your graph. Every change needs your approval and can be undone.
mcpClientHint: The token stays valid until you regenerate it.
mcpRegenerateDescription: The current token stops working and the server restarts with a new token. Update your external assistants with the new configuration. Your graph stays unchanged.
mcpUndoApproval: An external MCP client requests Undo on the shared document history.
mcpRedoApproval: An external MCP client requests Redo on the shared document history.
aiStarterAddPrompt: Suggest two new concepts for this graph and connect them to existing concepts.
aiStarterViewPrompt: Create a view grouping concepts about a common topic, without duplicating them.
aiStarterConnectionsPrompt: Which connections are missing from the graph? Suggest connections without changing it yet.
aiChatEmpty:
A question, an idea, a connection.
Explore and edit Nesso from here.
aiUndoTitle: Undo the last document change. If you changed the document after this message, your change is undone first.
aiRedoTitle: Redo the last undone document change. It may not belong to this message if other changes were undone after it.
aiChatCancelled: Cancelled. No proposed changes were applied.
aiChatFailed: Request failed. No proposed changes were applied.
aiChatStorageFailure: Chat could not be restored or saved. Existing unreadable data is preserved until you clear the chat.
aiEditApproval: {{added}} additions, {{updated}} updates, {{removed}} deletions and {{memberships}} membership changes. All changes apply together and can be undone.
aiDescription: Manage providers for chat and external assistant access to Nesso.
aiNewConnectionDescription: Choose how to connect AI to Nesso.
aiEditConnectionDescription: Update this connection. Saving does not change which connection is active.
aiConnectionsEmpty: No saved connections. Add a provider to start chatting.
aiDeleteDescription: This removes the connection from this device. This cannot be undone.
aiModelsLoadFailure: Could not load models. Enter the model ID manually.
aiModelsUnavailable: No models returned. Enter the model ID manually.
aiConnectChatGptDescription: Connect ChatGPT to use your paid plan (Go, Plus, or Pro) or credits balance in Nesso chat. Free accounts are not eligible.
aiReauthDescription: Reconnect this account to continue, or sign out to connect another account.
aiChatGptModelsFailure: Could not load available models. Try again.
aiChatGptDescription: Eligible requests use your paid plan (Go, Plus, or Pro) or credits balance, subject to account limits.
aiSignOutDescription: The ChatGPT connection will require sign-in again. API-key connections stay unchanged. After signing out, you can connect another account.
aiRevocationUnconfirmed: Signed out locally. Remote revocation was not confirmed.
aiRevocationDescription: Disconnect Nesso in ChatGPT settings to revoke access remotely.
aiVerified: Connection verified and ready to use.
updateReadyDescription: Restart Nesso to install it. Your work will be saved first.
updateInstallFailure: Restart failed. You can try again.
updateSaveFailure: Save failed. Nesso has not restarted. Resolve the storage issue and try again.
resetConfirmation: Delete everything? All concepts, relations, and views will be replaced by one new concept. This can be undone.
deleteViewConcepts: Also delete the concepts in this view
saturationHint: Left and right arrows change saturation. Up and down arrows change brightness. Hold Shift for larger steps.
copyColorFailed: Could not copy the color. Try again.
renameDescription: Only the name changes. Concepts and relations remain untouched.
deleteViewDescription: This deletes the view. If you also delete its concepts, they will disappear from the graph and every other view containing them. Deselect below to keep them.
newViewSelection_one: Starting from {{count}} selected concept. Views reference shared concepts, not copies.
newViewSelection_other: Starting from {{count}} selected concepts. Views reference shared concepts, not copies.
newViewEmpty: Starting from an empty view. Views reference shared concepts, not copies.
name: Name
saveFailure: Could not save {{data}}. Changes remain in memory.
readFailure: Could not read {{data}}. Original data has not been overwritten.
persistenceReplaceDescription: The original record will be overwritten with the current data in Nesso, without a backup. Unreadable content will be lost. Other records are not replaced.
persistenceReplaceDocumentWarning: The graph shown may be empty or incomplete because the original document could not be read. Export your current graph and check it before proceeding.
persistenceRecoveryFailed: Could not recover saving. The original record has not been replaced. Check the technical details, permissions and available space, then retry.
persistenceCloseDescription: Closing will discard changes that could not be saved. Keep Nesso open to resolve the storage problem. Existing files will not be replaced.
ambiguousRelation: Choose a relation type: this label has multiple IRIs.
singleSelectionHint: Select a single item to edit its label or relation type.
outsideConceptCount_one: {{count}} concept is outside the current view.
outsideConceptCount_other: {{count}} concepts are outside the current view.
outsideConcept: This concept is outside the current view.
label: Label
noSavedViews: No saved views yet. Create one in the Explorer.
allViewsConcepts_one: This concept is in all saved views.
allViewsConcepts_other: These concepts are in all saved views.
generalDescription: Choose your language and the plugins used by Nesso.
actionsHint: These built-in plugins provide commands available in the saved-view menus.
